headline.en: UNI +34% weekly on real TVL growth and v4 fee-expansion temp checks, but still 26% below the $5.96 DAO burn anchor.
headline.zh: UNI周涨34%,TVL放量叠加v4费用扩张Temp Check,但仍较$5.96 DAO销毁锚价折价26%。

keyChanges.en: TVL surged 21% in 7 days to $3.57B, confirming the 34% price rally coincides with actual protocol usage rather than pure token speculation.
keyChanges.zh: TVL 7天暴增21%至$3.57B,证实34%的价格涨幅与协议实际使用同步,而非纯粹代币投机。

keyChanges.en: Two live governance temp checks — Activate v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — could materially widen the buyback revenue base if either progresses.
keyChanges.zh: 两个治理Temp Check(Activate v4 Protocol Fees、Robinhood Chain费用扩张)在线,任一推进都将显著扩大buyback的收入基础。

keyChanges.en: Net emission remains +1.69%/yr: 20M UNI issued versus only 4.92M UNI bought back at $4.39. The market's core bear thesis is structurally intact.
keyChanges.zh: 净通胀仍为+1.69%/年:年增发20M UNI,而$4.39价格下buyback仅回购4.92M UNI,市场核心空头逻辑结构性未破。

contrarianObservation.en: 24h volume is only $14.36M on a $2.73B market cap (0.5% turnover) and perp OI is a trivial $22M. This rally has zero institutional footprint — a single whale unwind or the next slice of the 20M/yr ecosystem emission can round-trip the entire move back to $3.50 without warning.
contrarianObservation.zh: 24h成交量仅$14.36M(市值$2.73B,换手率0.5%),永续OI仅$22M。这波行情几乎没有机构足迹——一个巨鲸减仓、或下一批20M/年生态解锁,就足以把整个涨幅无预警地打回$3.50。

watchNext.en: Progression of [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees toward on-chain Snapshot vote — this is the single biggest fee-base expansion catalyst on the board.
watchNext.zh: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees向链上Snapshot投票的推进——这是当前费用基础扩张的最大单一催化剂。

watchNext.en: Price behavior at the $5.96 DAO burn anchor: a decisive reclaim signals regime change; rejection sets up mean-reversion back to $3-3.5.
watchNext.zh: 价格在$5.96 DAO销毁锚价的表现:决定性收复=范式转换;被拒=均值回归至$3-3.5的形态。

watchNext.en: Any new RFC reviving the real-yield-to-stakers proposal — its continued absence from top forum threads is a structural gap, not governance neutrality.
watchNext.zh: 任何复活real-yield-to-stakers提案的新RFC——其在治理论坛热帖中的持续缺席是结构性缺口,而非治理中性。

fullReasoning.en: The 34% weekly move deserves respect but not celebration. Three signals argue for constructive positioning over 1-4 weeks: (1) TVL grew 21% to $3.57B in seven days, meaning the rally aligns with actual usage, not pure token speculation; (2) two governance temp checks — v4 protocol fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — are live, either of which meaningfully widens the fee base feeding buybacks; (3) derivatives show no overheat: funding is flat at +0.01%, OI is a tiny $22M, L/S ratio 0.92 shows retail still net-short. Spot-led moves against short positioning tend to have better legs than perp-driven pumps. The structural problem, however, is unsolved. At $4.39, buyback capacity annualizes to 4.92M UNI versus 20M UNI emitted for ecosystem and development. Net supply grows 1.69% per year. The DAO's own $5.96 burn anchor sits 26% above spot — until price reclaims that level, the market is explicitly disagreeing with the DAO's fair-value mark. Notably absent from the governance queue is any resurrection of real-yield-to-stakers; without that pivot UNI remains a reflexive PE-multiple trade, not a cash-flow asset. Bullish stance at medium confidence: fundamentals are improving faster than price, but the thesis requires the v4 fees temp check to advance and price to at least test $5.96. Trade the setup with tight invalidation below $3.80.
fullReasoning.zh: 34%的周涨幅值得尊重,但不值得庆祝。三个信号支持在1-4周维度做建设性布局:(1) TVL 7天增长21%至$3.57B,涨势与协议实际使用同步,而非纯代币投机;(2) 两个治理Temp Check(v4协议费用、Robinhood Chain费用扩张)在线,任一通过都将显著扩大喂给buyback的费用基础;(3) 衍生品无过热迹象——funding rate仅+0.01%,OI仅$22M,L/S比率0.92显示散户仍偏空,现货主导+空头挤压的组合通常比合约驱动的拉盘更具持续性。但结构性问题未解。$4.39价格下,buyback年化产能仅4.92M UNI,而生态与开发年化增发20M UNI,净供应仍以1.69%/年增长。DAO自身的$5.96销毁锚价高出现价26%——只要价格未收复该位,市场就是在明确否定DAO的公允价值标定。治理队列中显著缺席的是任何复活real-yield-to-stakers的提案;没有这一转型,UNI仍是反身性的PE估值资产,而非现金流资产。看多立场、中等信心:基本面改善快于价格,但论证成立需要v4费用Temp Check继续推进、且价格至少测试$5.96。操作上以$3.80下方作为紧止损位。
